internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service Elevated Error Rate Due to Dependency Unreachability
internal.body:
At 11:42 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the cart service. Diagnosis identified the root cause as a dependency unreachability issue with the Valkey service, which caused the cart service to fail. The issue was confirmed by logs, metrics, and trace evidence. 

At 12:02 UTC, the mitigation action to disable the 'cartFailure' flag was proposed and approved. This action was executed immediately, resulting in a rapid recovery of the cart service error rate to normal levels. The recovery was verified by monitoring the error ratio metric, which dropped from 0.5 to 0.002 within minutes.

The incident was resolved promptly with no ongoing impact. Further investigation into the Valkey dependency's availability is recommended to prevent recurrence.

external.title: Some Customers Experienced Cart Service Errors
external.body: Between 11:42 and 12:02 UTC on November 8, 2026, some customers experienced errors when using the cart service. The issue was caused by a temporary problem with a service the cart depends on. Our team identified and resolved the issue quickly, and the cart service is now operating normally. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
